# Boldsign v0.8.0 - Table of Contents

> Unofficial BoldSign Elixir Library used to interact with the e-signature REST API.

## Pages

- [README](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Boldsign](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.md): BoldSign API Client.
- [Boldsign.Brand](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.Brand.md): BoldSign Brand API.

- [Boldsign.Contact](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.Contact.md): BoldSign Contact API.

- [Boldsign.ContactGroup](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.ContactGroup.md): BoldSign Contact Group API.

- [Boldsign.CustomField](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.CustomField.md): BoldSign Custom Field API.

- [Boldsign.Document](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.Document.md): BoldSign Document API.

- [Boldsign.File](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.File.md): Helper for preparing files for upload.

- [Boldsign.IdentityVerification](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.IdentityVerification.md): BoldSign Identity Verification API.

- [Boldsign.Multipart](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.Multipart.md): Converts a params map into a raw multipart/form-data binary.
- [Boldsign.Plan](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.Plan.md): BoldSign Plan API.

- [Boldsign.SenderIdentity](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.SenderIdentity.md): BoldSign Sender Identity API.

- [Boldsign.Team](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.Team.md): BoldSign Team API.

- [Boldsign.Template](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.Template.md): BoldSign Template API.

- [Boldsign.User](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.User.md): BoldSign User API.

- [Boldsign.Webhook](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.Webhook.md): Webhook signature verification for BoldSign.
- [Boldsign.Webhook.Handler](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.Webhook.Handler.md): Behavior for BoldSign webhook handlers.

- [Boldsign.WebhookPlug](https://boldsign.hexdocs.pm/Boldsign.WebhookPlug.md): A `Plug` for handling BoldSign webhooks.
